Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.about

Class AboutInfo

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.about.AboutInfo
public final class AboutInfo extends Object
The headless model behind AboutPanel: the product identity, the resolved build version, a snapshot of the host runtime (Java, platform, Java 3D) and the attribution / licence text shown in the About window.

Deliberately free of Swing/AWT imports so it can be exercised headless (the same split CalculatorEngine uses). Every accessor is a pure static read of system properties or classpath metadata, and the version / Java 3D resolution is factored into package-private helpers that take their inputs explicitly, so the fallbacks are unit-testable without mutating the JVM's global state.

The build version is not hardcoded here. It is resolved from the lg.version system property (which the Gradle run task sets to the canonical project.version), falling back to the jar manifest's Implementation-Version and finally to UNKNOWN. This keeps a single source of truth for the version instead of adding a fifth literal copy that a version bump could miss.

  • Method Details

    • is2D

      public static boolean is2D()
      True when the desktop is running as the conventional 2D/Swing desktop, i.e. when lg.fws.mode selects the MDI 2D shell. Reads the mode property only (no 3D probe), so it is cheap and headless-safe.

    • tagline

      public static String tagline()

    • credits

      public static String credits()

    • getVersion

      public static String getVersion()
      Resolves the build version. Reads "lg.version" from the system properties, then the jar manifest Implementation-Version, and finally UNKNOWN.

    • getJava3D

      public static String getJava3D()
      Resolves the Java 3D provider line. Reflectively reads the Jogamp org.jogamp.java3d package implementation version; on any failure (Java 3D absent from the classpath, as in a pure-2D host) it degrades to a plain provider name rather than throwing.

    • getFields

      public static List<AboutInfo.Field> getFields()
      The ordered system-information rows shown in the About window.

    • getFields

      public static List<AboutInfo.Field> getFields(boolean twoD)
      The ordered system-information rows for a given desktop mode. The conventional 2D/Swing desktop omits the Java 3D row, since it never loads the scene graph and its About box must not advertise 3D.
